attempts.answer:
The vendor directly providing **Online Gantt** (specifically the "AI Assistant for Gantt Charts" at **onlinegantt.com**) is **Online Gantt**. 

* **Evidence & Provider Statement:** The official product and feature pages on `onlinegantt.com` do not disclose a separate incorporated legal entity; instead, they explicitly cite the provider brand at the footer: *"Powered by: Online Gantt"* (as well as *"Provided By: Online Gantt"*). Official operational contact is maintained directly through `contact@onlinegantt.com` and `support@onlinegantt.com`.
